## WorkerThreadLaunch.ready() method

Wait for the worker to signal it's ready.

**Signature:**

```typescript
ready(): Promise<void>;
```
**Returns:**

Promise&lt;void&gt;

Promise that resolves when worker calls `super()` in `WorkerThreadInit`<!-- -->.

## Example


```typescript
const worker = new WorkerThreadLaunch("./worker.ts", []);
await worker.ready();
console.log("Worker is ready");
```
